verses.he: נָֽקְטָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֫יָּ֥י אֶֽעֶזְבָ֣ה עָלַ֣י שִׂיחִ֑י אֲ֝דַבְּרָה֗ בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.he: אֹמַ֣ר אֶל־אֱ֭לוֹהַּ אַל־תַּרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי הֽ֝וֹדִיעֵ֗נִי עַ֣ל מַה־תְּרִיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: I will say unto God: Do not condemn me; Make me know wherefore Thou contendest with me.

verses.he: הֲט֤וֹב לְךָ֨׀ כִּֽי־תַעֲשֹׁ֗ק כִּֽי־תִ֭מְאַס יְגִ֣יעַ כַּפֶּ֑יךָ וְעַל־עֲצַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים הוֹפָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.en: Is it good unto Thee that Thou shouldest oppress, That Thou shouldest despise the work of Thy hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

verses.he: הַעֵינֵ֣י בָשָׂ֣ר לָ֑ךְ אִם־כִּרְא֖וֹת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: Hast Thou eyes of flesh? Or seest Thou as man seeth?

verses.he: הֲכִימֵ֣י אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמֶ֑יךָ אִם־שְׁ֝נוֹתֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣ימֵי גָֽבֶר׃
verses.en: Are Thy days as the days of man, Or Thy years as a man’s days,

verses.he: כִּֽי־תְבַקֵּ֥שׁ לַעֲו‍ֹנִ֑י וּ֭לְחַטָּאתִ֥י תִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: That Thou inquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin, .

verses.he: עַֽל־דַּ֭עְתְּךָ כִּי־לֹ֣א אֶרְשָׁ֑ע וְאֵ֖ין מִיָּדְךָ֣ מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.en: Although Thou knowest that I shall not be condemned; And there is none that can deliver out of Thy hand?

verses.he: יָדֶ֣יךָ עִ֭צְּבוּנִי וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֑וּנִי יַ֥חַד סָ֝בִ֗יב וַֽתְּבַלְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me Together round about; yet Thou dost destroy me!

verses.he: זְכָר־נָ֭א כִּי־כַחֹ֣מֶר עֲשִׂיתָ֑נִי וְֽאֶל־עָפָ֥ר תְּשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Remember, I beseech Thee, that Thou hast fashioned me as clay; And wilt Thou bring me into dust again?

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א כֶ֭חָלָב תַּתִּיכֵ֑נִי וְ֝כַגְּבִנָּ֗ה תַּקְפִּיאֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Hast Thou not poured me out as milk, And curdled me like cheese?

verses.he: ע֣וֹר וּ֭בָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁ֑נִי וּֽבַעֲצָמ֥וֹת וְ֝גִידִ֗ים תְּסֹכְכֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews.

verses.he: חַיִּ֣ים וָ֭חֶסֶד עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝פְקֻדָּתְךָ֗ שָֽׁמְרָ֥ה רוּחִֽי׃
verses.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, And Thy providence hath preserved my spirit.

verses.he: וְ֭אֵלֶּה צָפַ֣נְתָּ בִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־זֹ֥את עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Yet these things Thou didst hide in Thy heart; I know that this is with Thee;

verses.he: אִם־חָטָ֥אתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּ֑נִי וּ֝מֵעֲו‍ֹנִ֗י לֹ֣א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: If I sin, then Thou markest me, And Thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

verses.he: אִם־רָשַׁ֡עְתִּי אַלְלַ֬י לִ֗י וְ֭צָדַקְתִּי לֹא־אֶשָּׂ֣א רֹאשִׁ֑י שְׂבַ֥ע קָ֝ל֗וֹן וּרְאֵ֥ה עָנְיִֽי׃
verses.en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head— Being filled with ignominy And looking upon mine affliction.

verses.he: וְ֭יִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁ֣חַל תְּצוּדֵ֑נִי וְ֝תָשֹׁ֗ב תִּתְפַּלָּא־בִֽי׃
verses.en: And if it exalt itself, Thou huntest me as a lion; And again Thou showest Thyself marvellous upon me.

verses.he: תְּחַדֵּ֬שׁ עֵדֶ֨יךָ׀ נֶגְדִּ֗י וְתֶ֣רֶב כַּֽ֭עַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִ֑י חֲלִיפ֖וֹת וְצָבָ֣א עִמִּֽי׃
verses.en: Thou renewest Thy witnesses against me, And increasest Thine indignation upon me; Host succeeding host against me.

verses.he: וְלָ֣מָּה מֵ֭רֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָ֑נִי אֶ֝גְוַ֗ע וְעַ֣יִן לֹא־תִרְאֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Wherefore then hast Thou brought me forth out of the womb? Would that I had perished, and no eye had seen me!

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־הָיִ֣יתִי אֶהְיֶ֑ה מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן לַקֶּ֥בֶר אוּבָֽל׃
verses.en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.he: הֲלֹא־מְעַ֣ט יָמַ֣י יחדל ישית [וַחֲדָ֑ל וְשִׁ֥ית] מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְאַבְלִ֥יגָה מְּעָֽט׃
verses.en: Are not my days few? Cease then, And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

verses.he: בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֵ֭לֵךְ וְלֹ֣א אָשׁ֑וּב אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: Before I go whence I shall not return, Even to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

verses.he: אֶ֤רֶץ עֵיפָ֨תָה׀ כְּמ֥וֹ אֹ֗פֶל צַ֭לְמָוֶת וְלֹ֥א סְדָרִ֗ים וַתֹּ֥פַע כְּמוֹ־אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.en: A land of thick darkness, as darkness itself; A land of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as darkness.
